text.en:
Maximum Salary Rate for the Governor/Chairman. The annual salary of the Metropolitan Manila
Governor/Chairman shall be equated to that of a Cabinet Member: Provided, that it shall be automatically
adjusted in accordance with any modification of the rate for Cabinet Members as may be subsequently

Maximum Salaries of Vice Governor/ Vice Chairman, Commissioners for Finance, Planning and
Operations and City Mayor/Vice Mayors of Manila, Quezon, Pasay and Caloocan. The annual salaries of the
Vice Governor/Vice Chairman, Commissioners for Finance, Planning and Operations and City Mayor/Vice
Mayors of Manila, Quezon, Pasay and Caloocan shall be equated to those of the Career Executive Service in
accordance with the schedule indicated below: Provided that the rates specified herein shall be automatically
revised in accordance with any modification of the rates for Career Executive Service Officers as may be
subsequently approved.
Equivalent CES
Rank and Grade
Vice Governor/Vice Chairman
Commissioners for Finance, Planning and Operations
City Mayors/Vice Mayors

Quezon/Pasay/Caloocan

Funding. The amounts necessary to implement the salary increase of the above-mentioned officials
shall be drawn from the salary savings or such other funds of the Metro Manila Commission or the city
concerned as are not otherwise earmarked for specific purposes.
Sec. 3. Effectivity. The increase in salaries authorized in this Order shall be retroactive to January 1981.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of April in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-two.
